prompts.text: Which film or television scene would feel completely different without its music?
Describe noticing a soundtrack before you remembered anything else about a movie.
Listen to a film score without watching the film or revisit the scenes where it was used?
We're asked to choose background music for a silent short film. Where would we begin?
A short musical motif can make an ordinary character instantly recognisable.
A quiet soundtrack can be more effective than music that constantly demands attention.
What movie theme do you associate with a particular character or place?
Recall an animated film whose music you enjoyed long after childhood.
Our group is making a short video about a relaxed afternoon. What kind of score would fit?
A piano-led film soundtrack or an orchestral score with memorable themes?
Which radio programme introduced you to music you still enjoy?
Tell us about hearing an unfamiliar song on the radio and trying to find its title.
A live presenter explaining discoveries or a playlist that simply moves from track to track?
We have one hour to host a friendly radio segment. How would we balance music and conversation?
The stories around songs can become part of why listeners remember them.
A presenter with genuine curiosity can make an ordinary playlist feel fresh.
What kind of radio discussion would keep you listening between songs?
Recall a favourite music broadcast that felt like an event in your household.
Our group is curating a small online station for a weekend. What's its theme?
An evening programme of listener requests or a morning show focused on new discoveries?
Which old recording would you love to hear restored without losing its character?
Describe discovering an older song because a parent, neighbour or grandparent played it.
Compare different performances of a classic song or explore how its original instruments were recorded?
A friend finds a collection of old records with no labels. How should we explore them?
Recording styles can tell you something about the technology and performance habits of their era.
Cleaner audio isn't automatically a better listening experience.
What feature of older recordings makes them interesting to you?
Recall recognising a familiar melody in a recording from another decade.
We want to make a listening session about the music our relatives grew up with. Who would we ask first?
Discover a forgotten local favourite or listen to a well-known album from an earlier generation?
What difference between two singers' voices makes you recognise them immediately?
Tell us about hearing a vocalist perform live and noticing something the studio version hid.
A soft, expressive delivery or a powerful voice that fills the room?
We each choose a vocalist to introduce to somebody who has never heard their music. What qualities would we describe?
The texture of a voice can carry emotion even when the words aren't familiar.
Technical range isn't the only measure of a memorable singer.
Which singer uses silence or restraint in a way you admire?
Recall finding a cover version that changed your opinion of the original song.
We want to compare the same tune sung in two very different styles. What would be fair to listen for?
A stripped-back vocal performance or an arrangement built around layered harmonies?
Which musical instrument do you think friends could learn together with little equipment?
Describe hearing a percussion pattern that made you want to tap along.
Try a simple group rhythm exercise or learn a melody one phrase at a time?
We're given an afternoon to make music with everyday objects. How would we create a rhythm together?
A small musical pattern can change character when a second player responds to it.
Playing in time with others is a skill worth appreciating even when the music seems simple.
What's a rhythm you can recognise before the melody begins?
Recall someone demonstrating how changing the tempo transformed a familiar musical idea.
A friend wants to understand what a groove is. How might we explain it by listening?
Explore hand percussion from several traditions or learn how a drum kit supports a band?
What effect does music have on the way you remember a journey?
Tell us about walking through an unfamiliar place while a song made the moment stand out.
Listen to the sounds around you during a trip or play music that fits the scenery?
We're taking an overnight train with time to talk. What sort of music would suit the changing landscape?
A familiar track can become tied to a very specific view or time of year.
Some journeys deserve silence as much as they deserve a soundtrack.
Which place has music playing in the background whenever you remember it?
Recall visiting a shop or café whose music made it feel different from others nearby.
We want to remember a holiday through a short playlist. What would make the choices meaningful?
Build a soundtrack before a trip or make one afterwards based on the memories?
What makes a music video worth revisiting even when you know the song well?
Describe seeing a video that completely changed your mental picture of a track.
A simple live-performance video or an elaborate visual story with a clear idea?
We're asked to shoot a one-minute video for a friend's original song. What setting would we choose?
The most memorable visuals can come from a simple concept executed consistently.
A video doesn't need expensive effects to reveal something about the music.
Which music video has a visual idea you'd like to discuss with friends?
Recall noticing a small performance or design detail on a second viewing.
Our group wants to make a music visual without showing faces. What objects or locations might communicate the mood?
Film musicians performing together or follow an original character through a short story?
What kind of music helps you stay present while working on something creative?
Tell us about discovering that a different listening environment improved your concentration.
Instrumental background music or familiar songs that don't pull you away from the task?
Our friends rent a shared studio space and prefer different listening levels. What would make the arrangement work?
The music that helps one person focus can be distracting to another.
A good work playlist doesn't need to be interesting enough to become the main activity.
Which sonic detail makes a track feel peaceful without becoming dull?
Recall finishing a project while the same quiet album played in the background.
We want a soundtrack for an afternoon of reading, drawing and planning. What features should we look for?
A gentle ambient soundscape or acoustic melodies with plenty of space?
Which song would you choose to mark the end of a memorable gathering?
Describe watching a crowd sing together during an event without needing a performer to lead.
End a party with an energetic favourite or a calmer song that signals it's time to leave?
We have to create a musical moment for a friend's farewell. How could it be personal without being awkward?
The order of songs can shape how people remember the end of an evening.
A familiar closing track can become a tradition without anyone planning it.
What musical moment has brought a group of strangers together for a few minutes?
Recall a celebration where the music suddenly matched the mood perfectly.
We're setting up a small birthday gathering for somebody who dislikes loud music. How would we choose a soundtrack?
Invite friends to dedicate a song or let everyone quietly add a track to a shared playlist?
What do you enjoy discovering about an artist after you've liked their music for years?
Tell us about an interview that made you understand a musician's process differently.
Read about an artist's musical influences or watch them demonstrate how they wrote a song?
We get to ask a local musician three thoughtful questions after a show. What would be worth asking?
An artist's creative habits can be as interesting as the finished recordings.
You can admire a musician's work without agreeing with every opinion they express.
Which album would you want to hear its creator discuss track by track?
Recall discovering a musician's early work and noticing how their style evolved.
Our group is making a short documentary about a neighbourhood artist. What story should it tell beyond their performances?
Learn about the making of a breakthrough song or the quieter work an artist is proud of?
